release_notes: Mushaf Zaid v1.1.56: Introduced new Recite & Review Mode (وضع التسميع والمراجعة) with shareable sessions, real-time mistake marking (Memorization, Hesitation, Tajweed), direct transfer of mistakes into main highlights, Android deep-link handling for recitation links, reversed swipe gesture flow matching the native Medina Mushaf layout, and persistent audio word toolbar.
